description: This file defines a JavaScript module for managing external OAuth connection fields within a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM interface. It provides methods for getting and setting form field values, showing and hiding fields, and handling specific field types like varchar and checkbox.

methods.name: getDefaultFieldGetter()
methods.description: Returns a default function to retrieve the value of a field element.

methods.name: getDefaultFieldSetter()
methods.description: Returns a default function to set the value of a field element.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified field using the appropriate setter.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified field using the appropriate getter.

methods.name: hide
methods.description: Hides the specified field's DOM element.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Shows the specified field's DOM element.

methods.name: getField$
methods.description: Returns a jQuery object for the specified field, using custom or default selectors.

methods.name: getFieldCell$
methods.description: Returns a jQuery object for the DOM element representing the field cell.

methods.name: getFieldType
methods.description: Retrieves the type of the specified field.

methods.name: getValueGetter
methods.description: Returns the appropriate getter function based on the field type.

methods.name: getValueSetter
methods.description: Returns the appropriate setter function based on the field type.
